name: Permafrost of the Ice Barrier
desc: You can only activate 1 "Permafrost of the Ice Barrier" per turn. When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from your GY to your hand. "Ice Barrier" Synchro Monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. If a face-up "Ice Barrier" monster(s) you control is Tributed by an opponent's card or effect, or is sent to the GY by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from your Deck or GY, then, if that monster was a Synchro Monster, you can banish 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
strings: Add 1 "Ice Barrier" monster from GY to hand
Banish 1 random card from opponent's hand
